body:
I believe modifications to the structure should not be allowed. In particular, if it causes a breaking change in compatibility, I cannot approve the merge.

Also, regarding overridable parameters, I believe this is the not good way because, for example, considering their application to chains of different lengths, it becomes too complex to implement in a way that is flexible and usable for many users.

If the proposal is to apply the same settings to multiple chains, I recommend an approach where an option is created to invoke a dialog for copying settings, and a button is added either to the menu bar at the top of the viewport or to the inspector when the SpringBoneSimulator is selected, which would then trigger that dialog.
